verdict_a.finding: The recorded native failure is correctly scoped to the driver targeting a panel Cancel that repick does not render. The repair targets the page picker overlay Cancel; the subsequent normal page click remains in the acceptance flow.
evidence: The original receipt records successful full extraction of three named rows before failing at cancel_click.
The product picker mounts #matrx-list-picker-host with an open shadow root and button#cancel; repick still waits for overlay detach and clicks #ordinary, asserting its click count is 1.
Cancellation detach and normal page click remain unverified until a fresh native run.

verdict_b.finding: The focused test asserts the exact overlay selector through the helper and would fail if restored to the original panel path; ordinary Playwright click options are absent. Existing completion assertions are unchanged.
verdict_b.limitation: This unit test records locator selection and does not itself exercise browser shadow-DOM click behavior; the retained native flow covers that on retest.
